flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The biggest move came in [[Kansas]], where the Democrat Adam Hamilton gained ground sharply, and the market now treats the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Maine]], the Democrat Troy Jackson also rose by a sizable margin, another predicted flip in the Polymarket odds. Republicans saw sizable drops in their chances elsewhere, including Julia Letlow in [[Louisiana]].
summaries.governor: The biggest moves in the Governor market came in [[Vermont]] and [[New Hampshire]], where Polymarket odds show sharp drops in the chances of the Republicans Phil Scott and Kelly Ayotte. In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sizable decline, and the market lists it as a predicted flip. Texas also moved, with a sizable drop for the Republican Greg Abbott.
summaries.house: The projected House count shifted to 239-196, down from 240-195, which still means Democrats gain control. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Cait Conley saw a sizable decline in the market's view of their chances, with Republican Mike Lawler also in the race. In [[CO-03 (Pueblo & Grand Junction)]], the Republican Jeff Hurd, who faces the Democrat Dwayne Romero, slipped by a moderate amount in the Polymarket odds.
